path_conditions: In byt_gpio_probe, the result of devm_kcalloc assigned to vg->saved_context (allocated under #ifdef CONFIG_PM_SLEEP) must be NULL-checked before any subsequent use elsewhere in the driver (PM resume/suspend handlers dereference it). The fix adds 'if (!vg->saved_context) return -ENOMEM;' immediately after the allocation. Buggy version drops the allocation return without any check.
